ph.description: Standard guideline range. Low pH causes corrosion; high pH leads to incrustation.

tds.description: TDS level below 500 mg/L is considered excellent. Higher values impact palatability.

turbidity.description: Turbidity should ideally be below 5 NTU for domestic consumption.

hardness.description: Hardness exceeding 300 mg/L causes scaling in pipes and limits soap effectiveness.

chlorine.description: Chlorine standard for health. Taste thresholds typically arise around 0.3-0.6 mg/L.

fluoride.description: Fluoride above 1.5 mg/L causes dental fluorosis; extremely high exposure causes skeletal fluorosis.
